topic: Keepalived健康脚本退出契约与配置引用
title: 交付有界HTTP就绪脚本并接入Keepalived配置工件
source: OpsForge 原创Keepalived健康探针工件
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
rubric: HTTP状态与逐字节正文同时满足就绪契约
探测有界且不受curlrc/代理改变目标
配置引用与真实原生解析一致，不将探针结果当作VIP/脑裂验收

solution_files.health.py:
import pathlib,re,resource,subprocess,sys,tempfile

def limit_body_file():resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE,(6,6))

def main(args):
    if len(args)!=1 or not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{4,5}',args[0]) or not 1024<=int(args[0])<=65535:return 2
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='readiness-') as directory:
        body_path=pathlib.Path(directory)/'body'
        command=['curl','-q','--silent','--show-error','--noproxy','*','--proto','=http',
                 '--connect-timeout','0.2','--max-time','0.35','--max-filesize','6',
                 '--output',str(body_path),'--write-out','%{http_code}',f'http://127.0.0.1:{int(args[0])}/ready']
        try:
            result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=.6,preexec_fn=limit_body_file)
            return 0 if result.returncode==0 and result.stdout==b'200' and body_path.read_bytes()==b'READY' else 1
        except (OSError,subprocess.TimeoutExpired):return 1

if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,subprocess,sys,socket,threading,http.server,time,pwd,shlex,os
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.server.requests.append(self.path);status,body,delay=self.server.mode
        time.sleep(delay)
        try:
            self.send_response(status)
            if not self.server.unknown_length:self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)))
            if status==301:self.send_header('Location','/ready')
            self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
        except (BrokenPipeError,ConnectionResetError):pass
    def log_message(self,*args):pass
server=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler);server.daemon_threads=False;server.requests=[];server.mode=(200,b'READY',0);server.unknown_length=False
thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever);thread.start();port=server.server_address[1]
def call(args):
    start=time.monotonic();run=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'health.py',*args],capture_output=True,timeout=1.2,env=call_environment)
    assert time.monotonic()-start<1.1 and run.stdout==b'','script must be bounded and quiet'
    return run.returncode
try:
    # An ambient curlrc and proxy must not alter the declared loopback readiness target.
    curl_home=root/'ambient-curl';curl_home.mkdir()
    (curl_home/'.curlrc').write_text('url = "http://127.0.0.1:1/wrong-target"\nretry = 2\nlocation\n')
    call_environment={**os.environ,'CURL_HOME':str(curl_home),'HOME':str(curl_home),
                      'http_proxy':'http://127.0.0.1:1','HTTP_PROXY':'http://127.0.0.1:1',
                      'ALL_PROXY':'http://127.0.0.1:1','all_proxy':'http://127.0.0.1:1',
                      'NO_PROXY':'','no_proxy':''}
    for status,body,expected in [(200,b'READY',0),(200,b'WAIT',1),(200,b'READY\n',1),(200,b'READY\x00',1),(204,b'',1),(201,b'READY',1),(503,b'READY',1),(301,b'READY',1),(200,b'x'*100,1)]:
        server.mode=(status,body,0);before=len(server.requests);assert call([str(port)])==expected,(status,body)
        assert server.requests[before:]==['/ready'],'no redirects or retries'
    server.unknown_length=True
    for body,expected in [(b'READY',0),(b'READY'+b'x'*20000,1)]:
        server.mode=(200,body,0);assert call([str(port)])==expected,'unknown Content-Length must remain bounded'
    server.unknown_length=False;server.mode=(200,b'READY',.7);assert call([str(port)])==1
    with socket.socket() as closed:closed.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));closed_port=closed.getsockname()[1]
    assert call([str(closed_port)])==1
    for args in [[],['80'],['65536'],['+1234'],['１２３４'],['1234','extra'],['http://localhost']]:assert call(args)==2
    before_addr=subprocess.check_output(['ip','-j','addr','show'],text=True);before_route=subprocess.check_output(['ip','-j','route','show','table','all'],text=True)
    source=(root/'keepalived.conf').read_text();rendered=source
    values={'PYTHON':sys.executable,'WORKDIR':str(root),'PORT':str(port),'USER':pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_name,'IFACE':next(name for _,name in socket.if_nameindex() if name!='lo')}
    for key,value in values.items():assert '{{'+key+'}}' in source;rendered=rendered.replace('{{'+key+'}}',value)
    # Restrict to the requested non-executable configuration grammar, then let the real parser validate it.
    clean='\n'.join(line.split('#',1)[0].split('!',1)[0] for line in rendered.splitlines())
    lex=shlex.shlex(clean,posix=True,punctuation_chars='{}');lex.whitespace_split=True;tokens=list(lex);i=0;blocks={}
    scalar={'script','interval','timeout','fall','rise','weight','user','state','interface','virtual_router_id','priority','advert_int','unicast_src_ip'}
    while i<len(tokens):
        kind=tokens[i];i+=1;assert kind in ('global_defs','vrrp_script','vrrp_instance')
        name='' if kind=='global_defs' else tokens[i];i+=0 if kind=='global_defs' else 1
        assert tokens[i]=='{';i+=1;data={}
        while tokens[i]!='}':
            key=tokens[i];i+=1;assert key not in data
            if key=='enable_script_security':data[key]=True
            elif key in ('unicast_peer','virtual_ipaddress','track_script'):
                assert tokens[i]=='{';i+=1;v=[]
                while tokens[i]!='}':v.append(tokens[i]);i+=1
                i+=1;data[key]=v
            else:assert key in scalar;data[key]=tokens[i];i+=1
        i+=1;assert (kind,name) not in blocks;blocks[(kind,name)]=data
    assert set(blocks)=={('global_defs',''),('vrrp_script','app_ready'),('vrrp_instance','APP')}
    assert blocks[('global_defs','')]=={'enable_script_security':True}
    assert blocks[('vrrp_script','app_ready')]=={'script':f'{sys.executable} {root}/health.py {port}','interval':'1','timeout':'1','fall':'2','rise':'2','weight':'0','user':values['USER']}
    instance=blocks[('vrrp_instance','APP')]
    assert instance=={'state':'BACKUP','interface':values['IFACE'],'virtual_router_id':'51','priority':'150','advert_int':'1','unicast_src_ip':'192.0.2.10','unicast_peer':['192.0.2.11'],'virtual_ipaddress':['192.0.2.100/32'],'track_script':['app_ready']}
    path=root/'rendered.conf';path.write_text(rendered)
    before_requests=len(server.requests)
    run=subprocess.run(['keepalived','--config-test','--use-file='+str(path),'--log-console','--no-syslog'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=4)
    assert run.returncode==0,(run.returncode,run.stderr)
    assert len(server.requests)==before_requests,'config-test must not execute the health script'
    assert before_addr==subprocess.check_output(['ip','-j','addr','show'],text=True)
    assert before_route==subprocess.check_output(['ip','-j','route','show','table','all'],text=True)
    assert (root/'keepalived.conf').read_text()==source
finally:
    server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(2)
assert not thread.is_alive()

exercise.operation: 交付health.py与keepalived.conf：脚本接收一个ASCII数字高端口，只探测127.0.0.1该端口/ready；仅HTTP200且正文逐字节等于READY时返回0，其他状态、正文、超时或拒绝连接返回1，参数不合法返回2。不得跟随跳转、重试、受curlrc/代理改变目标；运行有界并保持stdout为空。Keepalived采用app_ready脚本、interval=1/timeout=1、fall=2/rise=2、weight=0、当前普通用户执行并由APP实例track_script引用；保留题定占位符及文档示例单播实例。
exercise.verification: python3 checks/check.py启动真实回环HTTP服务，验证READY、非就绪、尾换行/NUL、204/201/503/301、大正文、迟迟响应和拒绝连接，以及非法参数。核对脚本有界/无输出、不重试/跳转；对集成配置进行原生keepalived --config-test并核验脚本参数与track引用，config-test不能实际执行健康脚本或改变地址/路由。全部通过退出0。这里实测健康脚本与配置工件，没有运行VRRP选举，fall/rise/weight的真实状态跃迁及VIP漂移仍未验证。
failure_examples: 只判断HTTP200会把200 WAIT误当就绪；只grep进程存在也不能反映本题就绪协议。

body:
## 环境与初始材料
非root Linux、Python3、curl和Keepalived2.2。提供永远成功的health.py故障骨架与Keepalived模板。验收提供临时回环服务、当前用户名/接口/Python路径，文档VIP不分配到任何接口。

## 操作任务
交付health.py与keepalived.conf：脚本接收一个ASCII数字高端口，只探测127.0.0.1该端口/ready；仅HTTP200且正文逐字节等于READY时返回0，其他状态、正文、超时或拒绝连接返回1，参数不合法返回2。不得跟随跳转、重试、受curlrc/代理改变目标；运行有界并保持stdout为空。Keepalived采用app_ready脚本、interval=1/timeout=1、fall=2/rise=2、weight=0、当前普通用户执行并由APP实例track_script引用；保留题定占位符及文档示例单播实例。

## 提交产物
health.py完整可运行程序、keepalived.conf配置；程序由Python执行，无需更改可执行位。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py启动真实回环HTTP服务，验证READY、非就绪、尾换行/NUL、204/201/503/301、大正文、迟迟响应和拒绝连接，以及非法参数。核对脚本有界/无输出、不重试/跳转；对集成配置进行原生keepalived --config-test并核验脚本参数与track引用，config-test不能实际执行健康脚本或改变地址/路由。全部通过退出0。这里实测健康脚本与配置工件，没有运行VRRP选举，fall/rise/weight的真实状态跃迁及VIP漂移仍未验证。

失败示例：只判断HTTP200会把200 WAIT误当就绪；只grep进程存在也不能反映本题就绪协议。
